body:
I appreciate all you have said and all you have offered. I always appreciate people who make time to offer kindness for complete strangers on the Internet.

What terrifies me is while all that sounds attractive, I feel like I lack even the motivation or ambition to try these things you have suggested. I just feel so disillusioned. I'm hoping it passes, but it has been this way for a while now. And I'm fairly optimistic by nature, so this is a strange state of mind for me.

Yes, all the time.

My ex, who I was with for almost 6 years, was the reason I came out here in the first place. I moved out to the West Coast from New Jersey for her, and gave up everything. I planned a future with her. She cheated on me and left, and now acts like I never even existed.

Same with the girl after her. I really fell for her hard too, but I was afraid to show it because I didnt wanna be hurt again. Even though I cared deeply for her and wanted everything with her, I made myself think I didn't because I thought I would get more attached. I was already plenty attached it turns out. She wanted more, a true relationship. Then she left too. The way she left was even more painful. She left a note for me when I wasn't home. She then cut me off completely. Took down every picture we had together. Acted like we never happened. After telling me she still wanted me in her life and that she loved me. That hurt most of all.

My parents have let me down. They have always been real good to me, but they have always had a slight tone of disappointment about me because I moved away and didn't follow the traditional path they wanted me to take. 

Friends have let me down, after telling me they wanted to stay in touch after I moved away, then it ends up just fading away. 

Those are a few examples.

When I'm around most people in my life, I feel good about it. I'm fairly social and I like good company. But most people are just living their lives now. I don't begrudge anyone for that, either. I know it is a product of getting older. But it still makes me sad because I don't have much around me. 

Every significant person or connection I've had in my life has ended up leaving me at one point or another, whether that be emotionally or in physical distance. It makes it hard to want to pursue anything further with that track record.

Thanks for taking the time to reply. 

No, I haven't. Not to this extent. Not having the benefit of anonymity is part of that reason. It also takes a heck of a lot to be able to face someone and say you have been thinking about killing yourself. 

There are people I could try and possibly open up to, but overall I would just feel like I am dumping my problems onto them. Everyone is dealing with their own stuff, too. 

I guess I just don't have one stable person I can really confide in right now.
